parameters.content:
## Zillow Research County Home Value Trend Scraper

**Actor:** [Zillow Research County Home Value Trend Scraper](https://apify.com/dataspryva/zillow-research-county-home-value-trend-scraper)

**Docs:** https://github.com/bolvein-firex/scraping-n8n-workflows/blob/main/docs/zillow-research-county-home-value-trend-scraper.md

### Setup
1. Create an Apify account and copy an API token.
2. In n8n, create a **Query Auth** credential:
   - Name: `Apify API Token`
   - Query parameter name: `token`
   - Value: your Apify token
3. Open **Run Apify Actor** and select that credential.
4. Click **Execute workflow**. The rows appear in **Rows ready**.
5. Optional: enable **Google Sheets** and set your document and sheet.

### Notes
- This calls the public Actor endpoint. No API token is stored in this file.
- `run-sync-get-dataset-items` waits up to 300 seconds. For large runs, switch to the async run + dataset endpoint.
- Public data only. Respect the target site's terms and local law.

### Input fields
- `mode` (string, required)
- `homeType` (string)
- `state` (string)
- `county` (string)
- `regionIds` (array)
- `asOfDate` (string)
- `historyGeography` (string)
- `startDate` (string)
- `endDate` (string)
- `sortBy` (string)
- `maxItems` (integer)

### Output fields
- `countyName` (County Name)
- `stateCode` (State Code)
- `stateName` (State Name)
- `metro` (Metro)
- `homeType` (Home Type)
- `latestValue` (Latest Value)
- `latestDate` (Latest Date)
- `change6mPct` (Change6m Pct)
- `change12mPct` (Change12m Pct)
- `vsBenchmark6mPct` (Vs Benchmark6m Pct)
- `rank` (Rank)

description: Zillow research county home value trend scraper: runs the Zillow Research County Home Value Trend Scraper Apify Actor, returns countyName, stateCode, stateName, metro, latestValue and more, then normalizes and dedupes the rows before an optional Google Sheets append.
